content:
Jimmy Kimmel on Monday mocked President Donald Trump and Melania Trump over some truly odd details in the new Amazon series about the first lady.

“This show is unbelievable,” Kimmel said. “It is the perfect program for those who are aware of Melania Trump, but wonder if there’s somehow even less than meets the eye.”

Amazon paid $75 million for production, distribution and promotion of the poorly received “Melania” movie that was released earlier this year, as well as this two-part series, with the first lady receiving at least $10 million, according to President Donald Trump’s financial disclosure report.

It seems like she filled a lot of roles for that money.

“At least according to the credits, she is listed as executive producer, creative executive officer, and styling and visual architect,” Kimmel pointed out.

But that also seemed a little fishy to the host.

“Now, I’ve worked in television for quite a long time,” said Kimmel, who has been in TV for some 30 years. “I’ve never heard of a TV show with a styling and visual architect or a creative executive officer. Much like Melania’s passion for Donald Trump, those titles do not exist in television.”

Kimmel also spotted another awkward White House moment that didn’t involve the first lady.

That came on Friday, when White House chief of staff Stephen Miller took over the briefing room with Trump, Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio looking on.

When he was done, the president was effusive.

“We have breaking news. He was better than these two guys,” Trump said, gesturing to Vance and Rubio. Then, turning to Miller, Trump asked: “Do you want to run for president?”

Kimmel found that hilarious given the reported presidential aspirations of both Rubio and Vance.

“Oh man! That’s who you sold your souls for, Little Marco and JD,” Kimmel said. “Stephen Miller gets a rose, you two get bent over in the fantasy suite.”

Then, Kimmel dug the knife in.

“Now you know how Eric and Don Jr. feel,” he cracked. “That was brutal. I think I saw JD Vance’s mascara running.”
